name: Thai Chicken Salad
notes: I often double the sauce recipe, and if there’s some leftover, it’s just an excuse to have this next week.

items: 3 cups chicken or turkey (cooked and chopped)
Crisp noodles (ramen will do in a pinch, or chow-mein noodles, or rice noodles fried if you’re feeling ambitious)

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Combine **⅓ cup hot water** and **2 Tbsp peanut butter** until smooth. Add **⅓ cup soy sauce**, **⅓ cup brown sugar**, **1 clove garlic**, minced, **1 Tbsp sesame oil**, **1 Tbsp sesame seeds**, **3 dashes hot sauce**, **1 tsp ginger root**, freshly grated, **1 tsp lime juice**, **¼ tsp lime zest** and **2 Tbsp green onion**, thinly sliced.

steps.title: Mix the greens
steps.body: Mix up greens, including bok choy, bean sprouts, cucumbers, romaine, water chestnuts, iceberg lettuce and grated carrots as desired.

steps.title: Top the salad
steps.body: Top with **3 cups chicken or turkey** (cooked and chopped), chopped peanuts, and crisp noodles (ramen will do in a pinch, or chow-mein noodles, or if you’re feeling ambitious, fry up some rice noodles). You can also add sunflower seeds.
